title: HubSpot refresh_token placeholders and non-value fields
summary: A refresh_token field holding an angle placeholder, a template or shell reference, a masked or empty value, a prose mention, and a token response with only public members.
rationale: A placeholder, reference, masked or empty value carries no credential, and the field name in prose is an everyday term. The token type word, the hub id, the scope names and the expires_in number are public members of the same exchange and are not values of the refresh token.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no credential value. That a placeholder, reference, masked or empty value, prose mention or public identifier is not a value is a project decision, not a HubSpot statement.

sources.supports: In the response, you’ll receive the access token along with the refresh token, which you can use to refresh the access token. (the example response JSON has the members token_type, refresh_token, access_token, hub_id, scopes and expires_in)
refresh_token | String | The refresh token value.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
